text:
OncallBot: :rotating_light: P0 Pager triggered — generation-api (west1) - spike in 5xx and tail latency. Symptoms: 20% 5xx over 5m, increased queue depth. Incident page: https://status.redwood.internal/incident/1809998888

Maria K.: taking driver — I'm live and on-call until 03:00. Starting quick triage now.

Shawn L.: I'll handle comms. Notifying account teams (Acme, BetaCorp) and posting initial note to #customers-status. Will post ETA updates every 10m. :thumbsup:

Maria K.: quick checks I'm running:
```
# check pods and restart-failed
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep generation-api
kubectl logs $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=generation-api -o name | head -n1) -n inference --tail=200
```

Ben F.: I'm on secondary coverage. If Maria needs help with cache or model rollout rollback, ping me. Noticed KV-hit rate dropped 30% in the last 6m.

Dave P.: FYI there's a canary rollout of model v2-quant that started ~7m ago in west1. If we see model-related OOMs or increased latency, consider pausing/reverting the rollout.

Maria K.: data: errors are mostly 5xx from model-service: `grpc: code = ResourceExhausted`. Suspect quantized kernel memory pressure. Next steps:
1) Pause model rollout to prevent further pressure (if safe)
2) Scale up generation-api to buy time (increase replicas + temporary node pool)
3) Trigger cache warmup after stable state

Maria K.: pausing rollout now: `/deployctl pause rollout v2-quant --target=west1` — executing.

OncallBot: Action taken: rollout pause requested by Maria K. — job id 98765.

Shawn L.: posted note to customers: "We're investigating increased errors in generation in west1. Team has paused a recent deployment and is scaling capacity. We'll update within 10 minutes."

Ben F.: while scaling, check `nv-top` on affected nodes; if memory pressure stays high we may need to revert to v1-fp16. Also check eviction logs on kube nodes: `/var/log/kubelet.log`

Maria K.: scaling replicas + requesting 2 extra g4dn nodes in west1 via autoscaler (request submitted).

Dave P.: if scaling doesn't reduce 5xx in 5m, plan B: rollback to v1-fp16. Maria you'll need to coordinate with infra to minimize DB/ksync churn.

Shawn L.: keeping comms cadence. Posted a short message to customers and created a status page entry. Will tag legal/ops for high-severity impact.

Maria K.: quick runbook excerpt for driver (from /runbooks/p0-generation):
- identify source (deployment vs infra)
- pause recent deploys in region (deployctl pause)
- scale replicas and nodes
- monitor 5xx and tail latency for 5m windows
- if persists, rollback to last stable model

Ben F.: I can take the rollback steps if we need them — will wait for Maria's call.

Maria K.: current plan: Maria driving, Shawn comms, Ben secondary/rollback ready. If we need infra-level reboot/escalation, ping @Dave P.

Shawn L.: noted. I'm adding a short timeline to the status page (t=0 alert, t+5m pause rollout, t+8m scale request).

OncallBot: Acknowledged assignments — driver: Maria K., comms: Shawn L., second: Ben F.

Maria K.: quick check-in in 6m to confirm whether scaling helped. If handoff needed at shift change, I'll create a takeover note for the morning oncall.

Shawn L.: one more: flagged a potential coverage gap between 02:45–03:00 UTC when night shift overlaps. If escalation is required in that window, I'm not reachable after 03:00 — please ensure morning oncall is pre-alerted.

Ben F.: noted, I'll be available for rollback during the gap until 03:15.

Maria K.: update 6m: 5xx down to 6% after pause + scale. Keeping driver assignment. Still monitoring.

Shawn L.: customer note updated (t+12m): reduced errors, team still monitoring; next update in 20m.

Maria K.: planned handoff: if stable at 06:50 UTC I'll pass to morning oncall with summary: actions taken, pending watchlist (kv-hit, node mem), and links to logs/runbook. @next-oncall please ack when you see takeover thread.

Ben F.: closing loop for now — will watch metrics and stand by for rollback.

Maria K.: confirmed handoff plan. driver=Maria K., comms=Shawn L., secondary=Ben F. — handing off when stable or at scheduled takeover time.

Shawn L.: thanks all — tagging owners in the status post and adding a note about the small coverage gap. :white_check_mark:"
